name: share-buttons
description: Share links for posts and pages (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Bluesky, email) as a partial and a section, with no tracking scripts.

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: Networks to show, in display order. Allowed: linkedin, x, facebook, whatsapp, bluesky, email. Leave empty for the defaults (linkedin, x, facebook, whatsapp, email).

style.title: Style
style.description: Icons and labels, icons only (the label stays available to screen readers) or labels only.

site_url.title: Site URL
site_url.description: For example https://example.com. Used only by the Share buttons section to make page paths absolute. Leave empty to render the section only when it has its own url.
